urban_rules.received: R8.15 brief §7-§14 (Mohammad promoted it to an Urban rule)

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification explicitly overrides it

urban_rules.applicability_rule: a doorway serving such a room: either side carries the room type through an authoritative, TRADE-SCOPED room-type map (never raw text alone)
not_applicable_to: external entrances (unless separate project evidence exists)
PAINTRY / pantry (not named by the owner)

measurement.rise_is: VERTICAL height above the adjoining finished floor
measurement.extent: the FULL CLEAR DOOR OPENING WIDTH x the physical threshold depth

floor_interfaces.wet: wet floor tile ends at the wet-side marble edge
floor_interfaces.dry: dry porcelain ends at the dry-side marble edge
floor_interfaces.marble: owns the complete threshold footprint (no half tile inside it)

supersedes_in_scope: QORTUBA-NEW-DRY-WET-TRANSITION-AT-DOOR-PLANE-OWNER-001@v1 where the rule applies (the split stays in force for any dry / wet door the rule does not cover)
never: 20 mm as a horizontal width or depth

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification explicitly overrides it

conditions: the opening genuinely has no door
the jamb is a real physical vertical surface
the floor finish reaches the jamb

urban_rules.principle: SKIRTING FOLLOWS REAL SKIRTING-ELIGIBLE WALL SURFACE AT FLOOR LEVEL; a plan-cut opening is not a floor opening without vertical evidence
urban_rules.trade: SKIRTING (and the hidden profile on the same path, US-08)
never: a window deduction from plan geometry alone
a sill height transferred between projects
